prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready to Play!", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, move, or open controls from your system tray.", "Try right-clicking your companion once onboarding completes.", "Quick Tip: Right-click to hide or control"]
1: ["Confirm Pet Appearance", "Check how your companion appears on screen before finishing setup.", "Looks Great, Spawn Now"]
2: []
3: ["Customize & Preview Your Pet", "Upload photos to generate a 3D desktop companion. Check the preview below to ensure high quality.", "Select Photos"]
4: ["Generating Your Desktop Pet", "We are polishing your pet's animations. This usually takes around 2 minutes.", "Estimated time remaining: ~90s"]
5: ["Save & Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Sign in to back up your pet, sync across devices, and ensure your progress is never lost.", "Your existing pets will automatically sync to this account."]
6: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose whether to pick from companion presets or create a custom pet from photos."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your pet and claim your free Starter Toy Box accessory upon completing adoption!", "Includes Free Starter Toy Pack"]
8: ["Quick tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or hide your pet at any time."]
9: ["Fast setup • Takes under 2 minutes to bring your pet to life"]
